summary: Completed testing of Analytics & Reports feature. All 18 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend Analytics page fully functional with KPI cards, revenue trend chart, interventions by status, technician performance table, top clients, and period selector (week/month/quarter/year).
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_service.py: Well-structured MongoDB aggregation pipelines for revenue, interventions, technicians, clients, and devis analytics
server.py: All analytics endpoints correctly protected with admin-only access (403 for non-admin users)
Analytics.jsx: Clean implementation with proper loading states, error handling, and responsive grid layout
Period selector correctly updates all data when changed (week/month/quarter/year)
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py - Created comprehensive test suite for analytics endpoints
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing data from previous test iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics feature fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) All 7 analytics endpoints working: /api/analytics/revenue, /api/analytics/interventions, /api/analytics/technicians, /api/analytics/clients, /api/analytics/devis, /api/analytics/trends, /api/analytics/summary. 2) All endpoints are admin-only (return 403 for tech users). 3) Period parameter supports: week, month, quarter, year. 4) Trends endpoint supports metrics: revenue, interventions, devis with configurable days (7-365). 5) Frontend Analytics page shows: 4 KPI cards, revenue trend chart (30 days bar chart), interventions by status (progress bars), technician performance table with ranking, top clients by revenue, and 3 summary cards for devis/clients/factures.

test_1_revenue_analytics.evidence: Returns current_revenue, growth_percent, pending_amount, pending_count, overdue_amount, overdue_count, average_invoice

test_2_intervention_analytics.evidence: Returns total, completed, in_progress, planned, cancelled, completion_rate, by_status, by_priority, by_category

test_3_technician_performance.evidence: Returns list of technicians with interventions_completed, interventions_assigned, completion_rate, avg_duration_minutes

test_4_client_analytics.evidence: Returns total_clients, new_clients, top_clients (with revenue), by_type

test_5_devis_analytics.evidence: Returns total_count, total_amount, signed_count, signed_amount, conversion_rate, avg_days_to_sign, by_status

test_6_trends_endpoint.evidence: Returns array of daily data points with date, label, value for 30 days

test_7_summary_endpoint.evidence: Returns combined revenue, interventions, clients, devis analytics in single response

test_8_admin_only_access.description: Analytics endpoints restricted to admin users
test_8_admin_only_access.evidence: All endpoints return 403 for tech users, 401 for unauthenticated requests

test_9_frontend_kpi_cards.description: 4 KPI cards displayed on Analytics page
test_9_frontend_kpi_cards.evidence: Revenue, Pending Invoices, Interventions, Conversion Rate cards visible with correct data

test_10_frontend_revenue_chart.evidence: Bar chart with date labels showing daily revenue values

test_11_frontend_interventions_status.evidence: Progress bars showing En cours, Planifiées, Annulées with percentages

test_12_frontend_technician_table.evidence: Table with Technicien, Terminées, Taux, Durée moy. columns, trophy badge for top performer

test_13_frontend_period_selector.evidence: Dropdown with Cette semaine, Ce mois, Ce trimestre, Cette année options - data updates on selection

test_14_frontend_summary_cards.description: Summary cards for Devis, Clients, Factures
test_14_frontend_summary_cards.evidence: Three cards at bottom showing detailed stats for each category

mocked_apis.note: All analytics use real MongoDB aggregation pipelines. Data may be 0 if no relevant records exist (e.g., no paid invoices = 0 revenue).
